en_title: Resident Evil Requiem Writer Teases DLC Plans, Immediately Says He Probably Shouldn't Have
cn_title: 《生化危机：安魂曲》编剧透露DLC计划，又称不该说
subtitle: 说漏嘴了？
opus_summary: 《生化危机：安魂曲》编剧Haris Orkin透露，他正参与DLC制作，后续内容将进一步刻画斯宾塞，让玩家更理解这个角色。他随即表示自己可能不该透露此事；游戏总监此前已确认大型剧情扩展计划，但尚未公布细节。

paragraphs.en: Screenwriter Haris Orkin has teased plans for Resident Evil Requiem ’s DLC. In a recent interview at Meadowlark Comic Con , he revealed that plans have been made to flesh out Oswell E. Spencer in upcoming DLC.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机：安魂曲》编剧Haris Orkin透露了DLC的部分计划。他近日在Meadowlark漫展接受采访时表示，团队计划在即将推出的DLC中进一步刻画奥斯威尔·E·斯宾塞。

paragraphs.en: "I’m working on the DLC for Resident Evil Requiem right now,” Orkin said. “We’re working hand-in-hand.”
paragraphs.cn: Orkin说：「我现在正在参与《生化危机：安魂曲》的DLC制作。我们在密切合作。」

paragraphs.en: In Requiem, Spencer was a completely different character to how he was portrayed in previous games, switching from maniacal mastermind to redemptive figure filled with regret. It looks like we’ll get a deeper look at that shift in the upcoming DLC.
paragraphs.cn: 斯宾塞在《生化危机：安魂曲》中的形象与此前作品截然不同：他不再是疯狂的幕后主使，而成了心怀悔意、寻求救赎的人物。即将推出的DLC似乎会让我们更深入地了解这一转变。

paragraphs.en: Later in the interview, Orkin spoke about his approach to writing villains. He explained that his villains always believe they’re the good guys of their story.
paragraphs.cn: 采访后半段，Orkin谈起自己如何塑造反派。他解释说，自己笔下的反派总认为，他们才是各自故事里的好人。

paragraphs.en: “We have an arc for Spencer in Requiem,” Orkin said. “Where you understand [that approach] more. And then in the DLC you will understand it even further. I probably shouldn’t say that, but yeah.”
paragraphs.cn: Orkin说：「斯宾塞在《生化危机：安魂曲》中有自己的角色发展过程，能让你更加理解这种写法。而到了DLC里，你会理解得更深。我可能不该说这个，不过，没错。」

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in the interview, he talked about his approach to writing Grace, an FBI analyst with limited field experience. “I decided to put her on the spectrum,” Orkin said. “She’s an analyst. She’s really an expert at figuring out clues, but she’s not great at dealing with people. It was all part of creating that character.”
paragraphs.cn: 采访中，Orkin还谈到了自己如何塑造格蕾丝。她是名FBI分析员，外勤经验有限。Orkin说：「我决定把她设定为自闭症谱系人士。她是分析员，非常擅长从线索中找出答案，但不太擅长与人打交道。这些都是塑造这个角色时考虑的一部分。」

paragraphs.en: The writer announced his two-and-a-half year collaboration with Capcom in February. Resident Evil Requiem released that same month and landed an 89 Metascore . IGN’s Resident Evil Requiem review returned a 9/10. We said the game “successfully splices two separate strains of survival horror together into the one highly infectious new mutation.”
paragraphs.cn: Orkin在今年2月透露，自己已与卡普空合作两年半。《生化危机：安魂曲》也在当月发售，Metacritic媒体均分为89分。IGN给本作打出了9分（满分10分），并评价道：「它成功地将两种不同的生存恐怖体验融合起来，催生出一种感染力十足的新变种。」

paragraphs.en: In March, director Koshi Nakanishi confirmed plans to launch a major story expansion for Resident Evil Requiem , although he failed to offer details. Presumably the DLC Orkin is talking about here is that.
paragraphs.cn: 今年3月，游戏总监中西晃史确认，《生化危机：安魂曲》计划推出大型剧情扩展内容，但没有透露细节。Orkin这次谈到的DLC，想必就是它。

paragraphs.en: By April this year, Resident Evil Requiem had sold over 7 million copies , with 5 million of those sold in the first five days of release. Producer Masato Kumazawa teased a potential Resident Evil game set in Japan , but Capcom isn’t done with Resident Evil remakes just yet.
paragraphs.cn: 截至今年4月，《生化危机：安魂曲》销量已超过700万份，其中500万份是在发售头五天售出的。制作人熊泽真人曾暗示，未来可能会有以日本为舞台的《生化危机》游戏。不过，卡普空也还没有结束《生化危机》系列的重制工作。

paragraphs.en: Whether you're still on your first playthrough or hunting down challenges in your fifth, IGN's Resident Evil: Requiem guide will help you every step of the way through RE9. Take note of these key tips and tricks before you get started, and focus on finding these important items early . Plus, our comprehensive walkthrough will make sure you don't miss a single Bobblehead or file as you try to survive from the Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center all the way to Raccoon City.
paragraphs.cn: 无论你是初次游玩，还是第五周目正在完成各项挑战，IGN的《生化危机：安魂曲》攻略都能在通关《生化危机9》的过程中为你提供帮助。开始前，不妨先看看这些重要提示和技巧，并尽早寻找这些关键道具。此外，从罗兹山慢性病疗养中心一路求生到浣熊市，我们的完整流程攻略也能帮你找齐所有摇头娃娃和文件。
